name: What is the 'recission period' for pre-construction condo contracts in Florida?

mainEntity.name: What is the 'recission period' for pre-construction condo contracts in Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Florida, buyers of pre-construction condominiums have a 15-day rescission period, also known as the cancellation period. This period begins when the buyer receives a copy of the condominium documents, which typically include the declaration of condominium, articles of incorporation, bylaws, and frequently asked questions and answers. During this 15-day window, buyers can cancel the contract for any reason and receive a full refund of their deposit. It's a critical time for buyers to conduct due diligence and review all project details. Kelby Contreras emphasizes understanding this right when reviewing purchase agreements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Florida law provides a 15-day rescission period for pre-construction condo buyers to cancel the contract after receiving condominium documents.
